PRESOLICITATION NOTICE

Project Title: Binghamton Federal Building and Court House 1st Floor Build-Out: Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) Construction

SOLICITATION NUMBER: 47PC5326R0002

Overview and Requirement

The General Services Administration (GSA), Public Buildings Service, Upstate Service District, intends to procure construction services for the build-out of the 1st Floor at the Binghamton Federal Building and U.S. Courthouse, located at 15 Henry Street, Binghamton, New York 13901.

This project involves the furnishing of all materials, equipment, labor, and supervision to complete the work described in the contract documents, including drawings and specifications developed by N.K. Bhandari Architecture & Engineering, P.C.

The total renovated space is approximately 3,015 Sq. Ft. and will be constructed as a Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF). Base interior work includes, but is not limited to: demolition, abatement, new walls, hard ceiling, doors, casework, woodwork, flooring, plumbing, electrical, IT, fire protection, and mechanical work.

Acquisition Details

Set-Aside

100% for Small Business Concerns

NAICS Code

236220 - Commercial and Institutional Building Construction

PSC Code

Z2AA - Repair or Alteration of Office Buildings

Size Standard

$45 million

Contract Type

Firm-Fixed-Price

Estimated Value

Between $2,000,000 and $5,000,000

Period of Performance

240 calendar days after Notice to Proceed

Anticipated Solicitation Issue Date

March 20, 2026

Anticipated Contract Award Date

June 5, 2026 


Qualification Requirements

Interested contractors must meet the following minimum qualifications:

  • Experience: Minimum 8 years of successful experience in comparable projects (size, complexity, and scope).
  • Past Performance:
    • All three required past performance projects must have a minimum award value of $1,500,000.
    • At least one of the three required past performance projects must be SCIF construction, performed as the General Contractor.
  • Key Personnel Experience: The Project Manager and Superintendent must each have a minimum of 8 years of experience in their respective positions.
  • Prohibition: The Company owner may not serve as the Project Manager.

Special Requirements

The contractor must adhere to the following special conditions:

  • Security: All personnel must meet HSPD-12 security requirements and any additional customer agency requirements.
  • Site Conduct: Cell phones and transmittal devices are prohibited on the project site.
  • Scheduling: Loud or disruptive work must be performed off-hours at no additional cost to the Government.
  • Coordination: The Contractor is responsible for coordinating all building shut-offs and roof penetrations with GSA Building Management and the Security Division Access Control (SDAC).

Definitization of Equitable Adjustments for Change Orders:

Information regarding GSA's policies and past performance data for definitization of equitable adjustments for change orders under construction contracts is available at: https://www.gsa.gov/policy-regulations/policy/acquisition-policy/construction-contract-administration

Submission and Contact Information

All responsible small business sources are encouraged to submit a proposal, which will be considered by the agency. The full solicitation package, including technical drawings and specifications, will be available on or about March 20, 2026 at SAM.gov.

This presolicitation notice is issued in accordance with FAR 5.101.
